enchantments.tooltip: Freedom of Movement: This item grants its wearer the ability to move and attack normally while under the influence of magic that impedes movement, such as paralysis, solid fog, slow and web.
Speed +30%: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 15% bonus to attack speed.
Natural Armor +13: Passive: +13 Natural Armor Bonus to Armor Class.
Reflex Save +11: This item gives a +11 Resistance bonus to your Reflex saves.

Adherent of the Mists Set (Legendary): 5 Pieces Equipped:+30 Profane bonus to Physical Resistance Rating+30 Profane bonus to Positive, Negative, and Repair Amplification+15 Profane bonus to Melee and Ranged Power+15 Profane bonus to Universal Spell Power
